update_policy: Keep component aliases, pin names, pin aliases, roles, electrical types, backend markers, and terminal support notes in this catalogue instead of duplicating them across stages.
Use explicit pin roles only where donor evidence or stable package knowledge exists; otherwise keep role/electrical_type as unknown until researched.
Adding a family should normally mean updating this catalogue plus focused tests/evidence, not editing unrelated pipeline stages.
